svg.title: A hydraulic system
svg.desc: Two fluid-filled cylinders capped with pistons and joined by a tube, the hydraulic line. A downward force F1 on the small left piston, of area A1, creates a pressure P1 that is transmitted undiminished through the fluid, so P1 = P2. On the large right piston, of area A2, it produces a much larger upward force F2. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Ideal pressure increment: F₁/A₁ = F₂/A₂. Small piston travels four times farther; weight/head
